```{r}
cellId1 <- "CD1"
cellId2 <- "CD2"
treated1 <- TRUE
treated2 <- FALSE
C1ncells_before <- 5415
C2ncells_before <- 8123
C1ncells_after <- 1432
C2ncells_after <- 7543

#combine these into vectors
cell_Id <- c(cellId1, cellId2)
treated <- c(treated1, treated2)
ncells_before <- c(C1ncells_before, C2ncells_before)
ncells_after <- c(C1ncells_after, C2ncells_after)
```
#isolating values in a vector
```{r}
all_my_pets <- c("dog", "horse", "guinea pig", "chicken", "cat")
my4thpet <- all_my_pets[4]
print(my4thpet)
```
```{r}
my_data_frame <- tibble(
  fruit = c("apple", "pear", "banana"),
  length = c(22, 30, 55),
  weight = c(150, 165, 170)
)


print(my_data_frame)
```
```{r}
my_data_frame <- tibble(
  fruit = c("apple", "pear", "banana"),
  length = c(22, 30, 55),
  weight = c(150, 165, 170)
)

gt(my_data_frame)
```
```{r}
my_data_frame <- tibble(
  cellID = cell_Id,
  treated = treated,
  num_cells_before = ncells_before,
  num_cells_after = ncells_after
)
gt(my_data_frame)
```
